name: tmolecule-widgets
description: Embeddable TMolecule storefront widgets. Built with Vite library mode, served via worker-seo at /learn/widgets/*. First widget: brew-guide (#2). Planned: tea-finder (#1), cost-per-cup (#3), ingredient-safety (#4, compliance-gated). See SCOPE.md.

scripts.build: npm run build:brew && npm run build:cost && npm run build:finder && npm run build:caffeine && npm run build:collagen && npm run build:sugar && npm run build:spice && npm run build:advisor && npm run build:steep
